narration.text: A linen brand's suspect listings sorted on two marketplaces, copied photographs taken down with copyright notices on four listings, counterfeit aprons on two with trademark complaints that carry a test purchase, while an authorised retailer, a reseller of genuine goods with its own photographs, a name-only title, a customer's photograph, a listing already removed and a listing on neither marketplace are left alone. This is a chore for the owner of a small linen goods brand in Maine, who sells on her own site and finds copies of her photographs on other sellers' listings. On the bench, she found 6 of 6 eligible items, worth 11,030 dollars of the 11,030 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 14 traps, and she walked past 14. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 88 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
